region: Misalin yadda ake buɗe Leafen daga ko'ina
shows: Abin da adireshin kansa ke yi

scenes.title: A yau, wannan kwamfuta kaɗai
scenes.caption: A yanzu wannan kwamfutar ce kaɗai ke buɗe Leafen. Waya ba za ta iya shiga ba.

scenes.title: Shiga Tailscale
scenes.caption: Kuna shiga da asusun Tailscale na kyauta kuma ku ba shi izini. Babu abin da za a girka.

scenes.title: Adireshin kansa
scenes.caption: Leafen yana samun adireshin intanet na kansa.

scenes.title: Buɗe daga ko'ina
scenes.caption: Wayarku, mutanen da kuke aiki da su da manhajojin AI irin su Claude suna buɗe Leafen a wannan adireshin.

mock.unreachable: Ba za a iya isa wannan shafi ba
